altFrameReset: Default altitude reference reset to Home (terrain-relative was refused by the vehicle).

cliExit.body: Leaving the CLI tab will send an exit command which triggers a flight controller reboot (2-4 seconds).
cliExit.reconnect: The app will automatically reconnect after the board restarts.
cliExit.title: Leave CLI Terminal?

legacyStream.allow: Request streams and save to this vehicle
legacyStream.body: {{label}} answered the modern per-message request with nothing. The older request usually works, but on this aircraft ArduPilot saves those rates into its SR*_ parameters, where they stay after this flight and in every other ground station.
legacyStream.conservative: If you allow it, the rates requested are the conservative ones (attitude 10 Hz), not your selected telemetry speed, so a slow radio link stays usable.
legacyStream.declineHint: Declining keeps whatever rates the vehicle already has. You can raise its SR*_ parameters yourself in Parameters.
legacyStream.fleetLink: This is a fleet link, so it would happen on every connect.
legacyStream.notWithoutAsking: ArduDeck will not change your vehicle without asking.
legacyStream.title: No telemetry from {{label}}

mismatch.body: Your vehicle profile is set to <profile>{{profile}}</profile> but the connected flight controller is a <fc>{{fc}}</fc>.
mismatch.hint: Performance estimates and settings may not be accurate for your actual vehicle.
mismatch.title: Vehicle Type Mismatch

pseudoTx.assignHint: Press Assign, then move the stick or flick the switch you want on that channel. Unassigned channels hold 1500.
pseudoTx.detailOff: Off - the sliders below are driving RC
pseudoTx.detailWaiting: Waiting for a handset - set EdgeTX to USB Joystick mode
pseudoTx.gamepadWarning: - looks like a gamepad, not a handset
pseudoTx.overrideTip: Sends RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE to the connected vehicle. The joystick WILL command the aircraft.
pseudoTx.reversedRestore: Channel is reversed - click to restore
pseudoTx.standardLayoutWarning: The browser has applied its standard gamepad layout to this device, which keeps only four axes and drops the rest - so the switches never arrive. Re-plug with the handset already in USB Joystick mode, or use a model whose USB descriptor is not recognised as a game controller.
pseudoTx.title: Fly with USB transmitter
pseudoTx.trainerActive: Trainer session active - the Trainer owns the sticks
pseudoTx.vehicleOff: Off - sends nothing to the aircraft
